title: Federated Learning by Utility-Constrained Stochastic Aggregation for Improving Rational Participation
abstract: arXiv:2605.18020v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) algorithms implicitly assume that clients passively comply with server-side orchestration, sharing local model updates upon the server's request. However, this overlooks an important aspect of real-world cross-silo environments: clients are often rational agents who may prioritize their own interests, such as local model performance, over that of the global model. In settings with significant statistical heterogeneity, rational clients may opt out of the federation if the perceived benefits of collaboration fail to meet their local utility thresholds. Such attrition degrades global model performance and can lead to the collapse of the federated training process. translated_title: 基于效用约束随机聚合的联邦学习以提升理性参与
translated_abstract: 联邦学习算法隐含地假设客户端被动服从服务器端的调度，在服务器的请求下共享本地模型更新。然而，这忽视了现实跨机构环境中的一个重要方面：客户端往往是理性的智能体，可能将自身利益（如本地模型性能）置于全局模型利益之上。在统计异质性显著的场景中，如果协作带来的感知收益未能达到其本地效用阈值，理性客户端可能会选择退出联邦。这种流失会降低全局模型性能，并可能导致联邦训练过程的崩溃。为避免此类情况，本工作提出了FedUCA（Federated Learning by Utility-Constrained Stochastic Aggregation for Improving Rational Participation），这是一种非货币化框架，通过建立非支付渠道，使客户端能够……
tldr: 提出了非货币化框架FedUCA，通过效用约束的随机聚合机制确保理性客户端的协作收益满足其本地效用阈值，从而提升客户端参与意愿、防止客户端流失导致的联邦训练崩溃。
en_tdlr: Proposes FedUCA, a non-monetary framework that employs utility-constrained stochastic aggregation to ensure rational clients' collaboration benefits meet their local utility thresholds, thereby improving participation and preventing federated training collapse caused by client attrition.
